<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Council Meetings</h1><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Council conducts the majority of its business in an open forum, with the only exceptions being those matters pertaining to staff, litigation and the private business of individuals where confidentiality has been requested.</p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Ordinary Meetings of Council are generally held on the third Thursday of every month at 3.00pm and generally conclude at around 5.00pm.  Determination of the day and time of the meeting is made by Councillors, usually at the commencement of the Council term.  All ratepayers are welcome to attend.</p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">An Agenda for each meeting is prepared by the second Friday of each month and can be viewed below or at the Shire offices at 55 Cowabbie Street, Coolamon.</p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Any person wishing to bring a matter before Council should lodge their request with the General Manager by the second Wednesday of the month.</p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Council’s Code of Meeting Practice details how the meeting will be held and details how deputations can be made to the meeting.  The Code can be found on Council’s Policies <a href="https://coolamon.nsw.gov.au/council-policies" target="_blank"><strong>page</strong></a>. </p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Council next meeting will be held on <strong>Thursday, 19 November 2026 commencing at 3.00pm. </strong></p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><strong>Business Paper</strong></p><p style="text-align:justify;white-space: normal !important;white-space:pre-wrap;" class=""><a href="/council-minutes-recordings" target=""><strong>Click here to access Council Meeting Minutes and Recordings</strong></a></p>
</div>
